title: Media provider boundary
deliverable: Define bounded image/frame/audio artifacts, metadata, dimensions and deterministic decode policy.
acceptance: Pixel/frame/duration limits are checked before allocation; corrupted metadata cannot request unbounded buffers.

title: Image decoding
deliverable: Add every required input image format and animated variant via reviewed feature-selected providers.
acceptance: Browser/native decode fixtures record color, alpha and frame semantics; unavailable codecs remain explicit gaps.

title: Image encoding
deliverable: Add reference output formats, metadata policy and deterministic options where possible.
acceptance: Quality settings and byte-level nondeterminism are documented; exact output comparisons use the right compatibility criteria.

title: Geometry transforms
deliverable: Add resize, crop, rotate, flip and related inventoried image operations.
acceptance: Coordinate bounds, interpolation options, orientation and very large dimensions are fixture-tested.

title: Color transforms
deliverable: Add channels, grayscale, inversion, brightness/contrast and required color operations.
acceptance: Color space, alpha premultiplication and clamping rules are explicit and reproducible.

title: Filters and effects
deliverable: Add required blur/sharpen/convolution and other image effects from inventory.
acceptance: Kernel costs and edge behavior are bounded; arbitrary filter input cannot cause uncontrolled GPU/CPU allocation.

title: Image composition
deliverable: Add layering, text/annotation and inventoried composition helpers.
acceptance: Fonts/assets are local and versioned; untrusted text remains inert and export respects declared dimensions.

title: Steganography and bit planes
deliverable: Add required image byte/bit extraction and embedding operations.
acceptance: Capacity limits, channel order and malformed payloads have round-trip and negative tests.

title: QR generation
deliverable: Deliver only qr generation within the source workstream: Add required symbologies and rendering options.
acceptance: For this scoped topic: Payload capacity, error correction and invalid character sets are checked against reference fixtures.

title: Barcode generation
deliverable: Deliver only barcode generation within the source workstream: Add required symbologies and rendering options.
acceptance: For this scoped topic: Payload capacity, error correction and invalid character sets are checked against reference fixtures.

title: QR recognition
deliverable: Deliver only qr recognition within the source workstream: Add local recognition for inventoried formats with deterministic input preprocessing.
acceptance: For this scoped topic: Recognition failure is explicit; no image is uploaded to a third-party recognition service.

title: Barcode recognition
deliverable: Deliver only barcode recognition within the source workstream: Add local recognition for inventoried formats with deterministic input preprocessing.
acceptance: For this scoped topic: Recognition failure is explicit; no image is uploaded to a third-party recognition service.

title: OCR
deliverable: Add a local OCR provider and required language/model pack handling with bounded worker execution.
acceptance: Model availability, accuracy corpus, memory costs and browser support are measured; absent languages are tracked gaps.

title: EXIF metadata
deliverable: Deliver only exif metadata within the source workstream: Add EXIF/ID3 and required metadata extraction/editing or display operations.
acceptance: For this scoped topic: Nested metadata, thumbnails and encoding variants are bounded; metadata is not interpreted as trusted markup.

title: Audio and other media operations
deliverable: Deliver inventoried playback/visualization/transforms using provider or browser presentation adapters.
acceptance: User activation requirements and codec support are visible; playback is never automatic for imported recipes.

title: PDF preview isolation

acceptance: For this scoped topic: Active content cannot access app origin, secrets or APIs; no unsupported claim of a full Rust PDF renderer.

title: Media qualification
deliverable: Close format/argument gaps, compare outputs using declared tolerances and test malicious media corpora.
acceptance: Baseline use works without WebGPU; optional acceleration produces equivalent results within documented tolerances.
